answers.workaround: It can be created with a script, at least partially. However, similar to code editor minimap some built-in graph editors (Visual Script, Visual Shader) can benefit from it as an option. And the implementation feels like a natural extension of the `GraphEdit` itself, so making it part of the engine allows everyone to rely on it and use in their own projects.
